attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited has intimated the schedule of investor meetings under SEBI regulations. A one-on-one meeting with Axis Capital is scheduled for 23rd November 2026 in Mumbai. The meeting is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meet. The information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited published advertisements in Financial Express and Vijaya Karnataka on November 16, 2026, regarding the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This publication follows the Board Meeting outcome communicated on November 14, 2026. The company enclosed copies of the newspaper publications with its letter to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The document also contains unrelated text in Kannada script discussing various topics including land acquisition, government schemes, and local news, which appears to be extraneous content not related to the corporate announcement. The primary action is the regulatory filing of the financial results advertisement.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was conducted on November 16, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified link. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Kaynes Delivers H1 FY27: Rs 18,987 million Revenue with 18% YoY growth and Order book crosses INR 100,000+ million".
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited filed a press release regarding its standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results. The company reported revenue of Rs 18,987 million for H1 FY27, showing 18% year-on-year growth. The order book reached INR 106,252 million as of September 30, 2026. EBITDA margin was 14.1% and PAT margin was 4.5% for the period. Working capital days stood at 169 days. The debt to equity ratio was 0.4 times. The information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The presentation is available on the company website and will be used for meetings with analysts or institutional investors up to December 31, 2026. The document outlines macroeconomic conditions including a rupee rate near 95, a repo rate of 5.50 percent, and inflation trends. It highlights global supply chain disruptions, component lead times ranging from 12 to 52 weeks, and price increases for components such as MCUs and MLCCs. The company reports a market capitalization of approximately 23,000 crore INR as of September 30, 2026, and revenue of 1.8k crore INR for H1 FY27. Business updates mention a semiconductor pipeline exceeding 2.0 billion components and ongoing construction for circuit manufacturing facilities.

attchmntText: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreements
voiceSummary: Kaynes Technology India Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a Joint Venture Agreement with Toyokawa Techno Private Limited to manufacture Thin-Film Transistor Display Modules. The Board also proposed the voluntary strike-off of subsidiary Kaynes Embedded Systems Private Limited, subject to statutory formalities. The auditor's review noted restatements for prior period errors. The consolidated results include a share of net loss from associate Mixx Technologies, Inc. of Rs. 60.02 million for the quarter and Rs. 104.40 million for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026. The auditor could not comment on adjustments related to the associate due to lack of reviewed financials. The meeting concluded at 21:30 IST on November 14, 2026.
